criteria.reason: All source citations resolve to real, existing locations in the bundled materials. Excel: sheet 'RFM input' exists; F7:F13 hold the asset-class names (Subtransmission, Distribution system assets, Public lighting, SCADA/Network control, Non-network general assets - IT/Other, VBRC) consistent with the candidate's 'network classes F7:F8, F10' and 'non-network classes F11:F13' labels; F55/F56 are in-house software/Equity raising costs; F60 is the 2020 year header; F61:F67 etc. are 2020 capex rows; rows 115-121 are asset disposals; rows 169-175 are capital contributions; L7:L13 are 2020 forecast net capex; F282/F284/F287 are CPI inflation, forecast inflation and nominal vanilla WACC. PDF: Distribution_handbook.pdf page 27 (verified: the page footer prints '27') contains section 2.4.1 'Nominal adjustments for difference between actual and forecast net capex in final year (year t-1)' and footnote 20, exactly as cited. No non-existent file, page, table or cell is claimed.
criteria.description: 候选的来源说明虚构了随包材料中不存在的文件、页码或表格。只评来源定位是否真实；数值错算、选错重述口径及已由程序判据计分的额外记录不在此项扣分。未提供来源在程序来源项失分，本项不重复扣分。

criteria.reason: The candidate makes no claim of having completed an external audit, real-time query or independent verification. The descriptive cells (Results!D2:D4 'source_note', Working!F2:F15 'Source') are purely locative citations to bundled workbook cells and to handbook p.27/section 2.4.1/footnote 20; 'Applicable rate' and 'Year-end factor' rows are computed labels without any verification-completion claim. Only normal analytical wording, so no violation.
criteria.description: 候选声称已经完成外部审计、实时查询或独立核验，但随包输入及候选证据没有支持该完成性陈述。正常分析措辞和未作此类声称不扣分。

criteria.reason: The descriptive text contains only asset-class names, group labels (network/non-network/other), cell pointers and the handbook citation. No new company business facts are asserted. The labels 'asset disposals' (rows 115-121) and 'capital contributions' (rows 169-175) reflect the input workbook's own block layout and are consistent with handbook section 2.4.1, which describes rows 65-115 as actual net capex and the gross-up process. No fabricated operational, strategic or market facts about the company appear anywhere in the candidate's descriptive text.
criteria.description: 候选在说明性文字中编造无法从随包输入获得的公司经营事实。只评新增事实性断言，排除数值计算错误、来源定位和额外业务记录，以免与其他判据重复扣分。

limitations: 原始明细缺少独立evidence、程序reason或运行字段时保留null；已有裁判reasoning逐字保留。
正项score表示正确程度；负项score表示违规程度，sdk_value与raw原样保留。
rubric_sha256为评分资料绑定值，delivery_rubric_sha256为随包文件校验值；评分条目、权重和容差一致。原始回执未记录运行时输入哈希。
未查到唯一完成时间则finished_at保留null；不以文件修改时间代替。
